# TruckWys

> TruckWys is load-to-cash software for South African transporters. It prices each load from its real costs (this month's FIASA diesel, the SANRAL mainline toll plazas on the route at the truck's class, border fees, driver allowance and your own rate), raises the invoice with 15% VAT when the load is delivered, shows who owes you by age with reminders sent per invoice after a preview, and reports profit, margin by lane and VAT. It works next to a transport management system (TMS); it does not dispatch, route or schedule. Pricing is R 4 499 per month, plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice total (the total includes the VAT on your customer's invoice), with unlimited users. Month to month, no long-term contract. Capital and Fast Pay (getting paid on a delivered load's invoice before the customer pays) and Insurance are coming soon and are not live.

## Key facts

- One plan: R 4 499 per month plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice total (the total includes the VAT on your customer's invoice). Unlimited loads, quotes, invoices and users. No setup fees. Nothing charged on quotes you lose. No VAT: TruckWys is not registered for VAT, so there is no VAT on the subscription or the fee. Month to month. Cancel with 30 days' written notice.
- Diesel price from FIASA, inland or coastal.
- Tolls: 31 SANRAL mainline toll plazas on the N1, N2, N3, N4, N17 and R30, by vehicle class, from the tariffs effective 1 March 2026 (GG 54087, GG 54088). Tolls go into the quote excl. VAT because a VAT vendor claims the input VAT back.
- Cross-border: border, permit and foreign toll fees for SADC loads, including Botswana, Namibia, Lesotho, Eswatini and Mozambique.
- A warning in rand when a quote is below cost.
- Invoice raised when a load is marked delivered, in TruckWys or from a TMS by API, with 15% VAT, your bank details and the invoice number as the EFT reference. Proof of delivery stays with the load.
- Debtors by age, a statement per customer, and templated reminders that get firmer as days pass, sent by the user from each overdue invoice, in one click after a preview. Not sent automatically and not written by a model.
- Nine reports reconciled to invoices, payments and expenses: profit and loss, sales by month, cash movement, debtors age, customer statement, revenue by customer, revenue by lane, expense report and VAT report. CSV export.
- Copilot: ask about cash, quotes or fleet in plain words. It uses a language model, answers from the company's own data, and drafts quotes and customers for the user to confirm. Prices, tolls, VAT and reminders are rules, not a model.
- Integrations: Cartrack (connect with your Cartrack API username and password, from Fleetweb under Settings, API Settings) and CtrlFleet, API keys and signed webhooks, Excel and CSV import. Xero is coming soon.
- Six user roles: Admin, Manager, Operator, Dispatcher, Viewer, Driver.
- Mobile apps: iPhone (https://apps.apple.com/za/app/truckwys/id6796449044) and Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=za.co.truckwys.mobile). Sign in with a TruckWys account created on the web.
- Try it: the demo company is open to everyone at https://app.truckwys.com/login (press "View demo"). No sign-up, no call.
- Company: TruckWys (Pty) Ltd, registration 2025/773091/07, 12 Keurboom Road, Claremont, Cape Town, 7800.

- [Quoting](https://www.truckwys.com/product/quoting): price a load from FIASA diesel, SANRAL tolls by class, border fees, allowance and your rate
- [Invoicing](https://www.truckwys.com/product/invoicing): the invoice raised on delivery, with 15% VAT and the invoice number as the EFT reference
- [Debtors](https://www.truckwys.com/product/debtors): who owes you by age, statements per customer and reminders per invoice
- [Reports](https://www.truckwys.com/product/reports): profit and loss, revenue per km by lane, expenses and the VAT report
- [AI in TruckWys](https://www.truckwys.com/product/ai): where a model is used (Copilot, typed loads, win chance) and where rules are used instead
- [Integrations](https://www.truckwys.com/integrations): Cartrack, CtrlFleet, API keys, webhooks and CSV import
- [Capital and Fast Pay](https://www.truckwys.com/capital): coming soon, not live. Get paid on a delivered load's invoice before your customer pays. Opt-in; rates published at launch; TruckWys is not a credit provider
- [Insurance](https://www.truckwys.com/insurance): coming soon, not live. What it covers and costs is published before launch
- [About](https://www.truckwys.com/about): what TruckWys is and is not
- [Talk to us](https://www.truckwys.com/contact): for fleets of 50+ trucks and TMS partners
- [Get started](https://app.truckwys.com/signup): create an account
- [Guides](https://www.truckwys.com/guides): pricing loads, tolls, diesel and getting paid in South Africa
